scenes.description: A satisfied adult at a table just finishing a generous slice of cake, holding the fork beside an almost clean dessert plate with only crumbs and a dab of cream left. Emphasize having polished the food off.
A calm dog touches an outstretched palm with the tip of its tongue.
A child playfully shows the tip of their tongue in a friendly close portrait.
Fingers pull a blank sticker's corner outward so it curls away from a smooth glass jar.
